I haven’t known you long or had much of an opportunity to get to know you but I would have to say that my favorite thing about you is your homemade jam!!!  I can also depend on getting a greeting card on almost all holidays! And the most important thing is that my husband adores you so you are pretty alright! 

Have a lovely 70th Aunt Julie. I hope it’s the best one yet!

name: Kayla
message:
You’ve bought some of my earliest paintings and have always been so encouraging to me. You’re always sharing my artwork with friends through social media and many of those friends have become supporters as well. When I launched my yearly planner a few years ago, you preordered several copies right away and gave them as gifts to friends. 

Words can’t express my gratitude for your belief in me and support of my art practice. It means the world! Thank you for being one of my very best art collectors ❤️

name: Kayla
message: I’ll never forget the year you lost grandmas ring after you made the apple to bring to Twisp on family vacation, and Jan telling us to “keep an eye out” for your ring as we ate it. We never found it baked in the pie, but you did- several months later when you opened your recipe book!

name: Kayla
message:
That one Christmas when you got a “Hot Fathers” calendar from your sister Jan 😂 

I know the holidays have officially begun when you and Toni get to town and we take our annual trip to Harbinger winery. I love having you with us every Christmas- we always have so much fun!

name: Joe
message: I’ll always remember all the meals we shared (or I should say you bought me) during my college years. The sub shop, Izzy’s pizza, Boston Market, and many more. It was such a blessing during those years and made my time at Concordia feel more like home! Just glad you weren’t my RA. I would have had a lot more explaining to do😂

message: Growing up I remember the excitement every time I’d get to see Aj! (It’s never gone away). You’ve always been such a loving aunt to me, and helped create some of the best and funniest memories that I have! I’d say we’ve always been quite the duo together. You taught me how to prank people and cause a little havoc 😂. Thank you Aj for always spoiling me, treating me with so much care & kindness, for always encouraging my silly side, and to fully be myself even as I’ve grown up. Love you!!♥️

Hahahahhaha

name: Tara
message: Some of my most favorite times were being at your place or maybe it didn’t even have to be at your place on Thanksgiving. It could be other locations like Mark and Melissa‘s but you just sort of embodied the spirit of the fun that we had on Thanksgiving and some of my favorite things were when we did the games. I absolutely loved the turkey hat and the games in the competition and the fun. We would just crack up. It’s truly a gift that you gave to the family by cultivating that.

name: Geoff
message:
AJ, where do I begin? 
Yes, the summers at your place collecting game pieces for free fries, running through the sprinklers in your Celica hanging out of your sunroof, champagne toasts, scary movies, leather pants and Hall and Oates. You have always been a source of Joy, Happiness, Laughter, and Love.  Thank you!

name: Geoff
message:
As an “adult” watching how my kids have the same excitement, respect, and love for you as I did growing up.
 
Traveling to Kona for vacation and meeting a stranger, talking to them for 10 minutes and having the conversation turn to Auntie Julie!  
Your love, your kindness are felt the world over!

Me trying to shove dough up your nose and then you throwing it out the car window. You did tell me you were going to do that if I did it one more time…well,
I did it one more time Lol 
Going to Thorns games, having American Idol/dinner nights, vacationing in Twisp, photo bombing a family photo in Disneyland, the list goes on and on. Everybody needs an AJ!! You are an amazing aunt and human being! I love you more!!😉😘
